scope: First-frame actual-proposal initialization diagnostic only; not held-out detection accuracy or continuous identity performance
matching: Generate and cache every actual detector proposal before loading annotations. Score maximum-cardinality one-to-one IoU>=0.5; never replace proposal bounds with annotation bounds.
limitations: Frame0 is included in this model's early-frame training data: the result is optimistic initialization feasibility, not independent generalization.
Coverage ceiling assumes an ideal farmer correctly labels every matched proposal and rejects every false proposal.
Matching does not prove a predicted box contains a clean single-animal segmentation seed. No SAM masks or continuous tracking are run.
Only frame0 is decoded. Reserved footage remains unopened. No confidence tuning is allowed.
